decision.rationale: ECG (Electrocardiogram per the abbreviation entry) is an examination; the footnotes and the 12-lead ECG measurement entry give only timing, triplicate recording and method ('Standard 12-lead ECGs') and name no single measure in the recordings, so the rule's procedure stands.
Assessment of subsequent anti-cancer therapies every 90 days after study treatment discontinuation records therapies given, not an assessment of the patient.
